channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Compare how India's media, left, centre and right, covers each story, side by side.

item.title: Xhaka Admits Fake COVID Certificate, Investigation Launched
item.description: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka has admitted to obtaining a fake COVID-19 vaccination certificate. An investigation has been launched into the matter. Xhaka will skip Switzerland's Nations League games. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Sydney boy critically injured in shooting incident
item.description: An 11-year-old boy is in serious condition after being shot in the face and neck inside a home in Sydney's northwest. Three 18-year-old men were arrested at the unit. Police downplayed any link to organized crime. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The mortal remains of two Malayali women, who were murdered in California, USA, have been brought to Kerala. The specific details of the murders and the identities of the victims were not provided in the coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A Home Guard has been arrested in Hyderabad following the circulation of a video that shows him beating and dragging a woman by her hair. Separately, a constable reportedly died by suicide after a video call with a woman. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
